thread:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT: gpu-queue-growth detected for cluster 'eu-west-gpu' — queue length > 120 for 6m, 503 throttles observed. Assigning to @Maya R (oncall).
Maya R: on it. pulling latest dashboard now — @Kris SRE FYI in case autoscaler needs manual intervention.
Maya R: current symptoms — steady queue growth on model-serving deployments (text-gen-prod-*), CPU fine, GPU allocation exhausted. Autoscaler logs show repeated 'scale delta suppressed: maxNodesReached'.
Aj Patel: hitting nodepool max? which pool and what's configured max?
Maya R: pool=gpuneon-eu, maxNodes=40 per kube autoscaler policy, current nodes=40. Pods are Pending with events: "FailedScheduling: Insufficient gpu.com/rtx".
Kris SRE: confirmed. autoscaler event excerpt: ```time=\"2026-03-15T09:12:03Z\" level=info msg=\"scaleUp: desired=44, max=40, suppressed=true\"```
Julie Ops: queue backlog causing degraded latency for a handful of onboarded customers. We should check burst capacity and whether Dedicated reserved capacity can take traffic.
Neru PM: which customers are impacted, severity? Ops, can you confirm CS? @Jade CS?
Jade CS: CX alerting shows elevated error rates for tenant 'stedi-ai' and 'formsly' — both experiencing >30% reqs 5xx over the last 8m. Notified account leads.
Maya R: mitigation options: 1) request manual raise of autoscaler maxNodes to 60 for gpuneon-eu (fast), 2) scale down non-prod pools and cordon/evict for immediate node reuse (risky), 3) failover traffic to alternative model variants in other regions (more latency for customers).
Kris SRE: recommend manual cap raise + automated policy guardrails: increase maxNodes to 60, set a 30m TTL for the override, and start draining least-priority non-prod pods. I'll prepare the change.
Maya R: adding runbook snippet for manual bump: ```# kubectl patch cluster-autoscaler -n infra \napiVersion: autoscaling/v1 \nkind: ClusterAutoscaler \nmetadata:\n  name: gpuneon-autoscaler \nspec:\n  maxNodes: 60``` — ops will apply with audit note. Also need cloud provider quota check before we request in console.
Julie Ops: quota check passed for eu-west project: GPUs available=30 spare. We have to request a short-lived capacity grant from infra for 20 additional GPUs. I'll open ticket and ping infra.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: On-call acknowledged at 2026-03-15T09:18:02Z. Paging escalated to SRE.
Aj Patel: also patch pod disruption budgets to allow evictions on low-priority workloads: `kubectl patch pdb -n sandbox sandbox-pdb -p '{"spec":{"minAvailable":0}}'` — prepped but hold until we coordinate.
Maya R: moving to manual cap raise. Julie, please run the cloud quota ticket and approve override. Kris, please prepare the CA patch and safety TTL. Aj, stage the pdb patch but don't apply yet. Jade, keep CS comment updated: mention planned 20-30m mitigation window and potential retries required.
Julie Ops: ticket created: INFRA-8271. Requesting 20 GPUs to eu-west, priority=urgent. Pinged infra-oncall. ETA for approval 10m.
Kris SRE: CA patch ready. Will apply with annotation `manual-unblock-3620000001` after infra approval. Also enabling short-term scaleback policy to roll down to 40 after 30m: ```annotations: autoscaler.k8s.redwood/temporary-max: \"60\" autoscaler.k8s.redwood/ttl-minutes: \"30\"```
Maya R: customer impact note for status page: \"We are experiencing increased request errors and latency for some customers in EU region due to GPU capacity exhaustion. Engineers are performing a short-term capacity increase while we scale non-prod down. A permanent fix is being worked on.\" Draft posted to internal status channel.
Jade CS: sent external message to affected customers with mitigation plan and ETA. Logged for follow-up.
incident-bot: ACTION: waiting for INFRA-8271 approval. Current queue length=138, 5xx rate tenant stedi-ai=42%, formsly=35%.
Julie Ops: INFRA-8271 approved by infra-oncall at 2026-03-15T09:29:10Z. Granting 20 GPUs to project 'redwood-eu-prod' for 45m.
Kris SRE: applying CA patch now. ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: autoscaling/v1
kind: ClusterAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: gpuneon-autoscaler
spec:
  maxNodes: 60
EOF```
Maya R: watching cluster events...
incident-bot: EVENT: new nodes provisioning (3/20) — provider logs indicate node startup success for 3 nodes at 09:34:21Z.
Aj Patel: starting eviction of pre-staged non-prod pods (sandbox) to free GPUs. Running drains on sandbox nodes.
Maya R: pods scheduling now, queue decreasing: live queue=64 (was 138). 5xx rates trending down.
Jade CS: customers acknowledged the update and reported initial improvement.
Kris SRE: autoscaler now sees headroom: ```time=\"2026-03-15T09:40:02Z\" level=info msg=\"scaleUp: desired=52, max=60, proceeding\"```
Maya R: mitigation successful so far. Keeping manual maxNodes in place for TTL 30m. After TTL we'll evaluate whether to keep higher capacity or revert to baseline and pursue long-term fixes (shard autoscaler policies, reclassify low-priority workloads).
Neru PM: schedule post-incident review and include cost impact, SLA hits, and customer timeline.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVE CHECK: last 5xx <= baseline for 10m. Waiting 20m for sustained recovery before close.
Maya R: handing off to Kris for monitoring and postmortem. I'm off-call in 6m.
Kris SRE: ack. Will own postmortem and include timeline, runbook gaps, and suggestions (automatic emergency-burst pool or policy-linked preemptible fallback).
Jade CS: will track customer follow-ups and collect logs for support tickets.
incident-bot: THREAD NOTE: created incident record INC-3620000001."
